entry.title: The looming turn in degrees, at each input strength (14 Oct 2026, our own test, pre-registered, simulated body): left eye: In the body, the fly turned away from 30 spikes/s per looming neuron upward on this side, the strength at which the brain's turn command appeared; the turn was about 11 deg at 30 and about 37 deg at 80 (our mapping turns the brain's rates into steering). Right eye: At 30 spikes/s the turn was borderline: the fly turned away in 1 of 2 runs on this side; from 40 upward it turned away in every run. The right-eye borderline rests on one run (seed 0 at 30 spikes/s, 9.18 deg against the 10 deg rule). These body runs turn the brain's firing rates into steering through our own hand-made mapping, so they show the brain result in degrees; they are not a separate test of the wiring. No scrambled brains were run at these strengths.

Body lines under the 13 Oct relay headline, which stays the headline (14 Oct 2026, descriptive, one run per arm and side): With PVLP141 silenced, the fly still turned away, by about 24 deg instead of 37 deg (one run per side; our mapping). With all 21-23 two-step relay neurons silenced, the fly still turned away, by about 37 deg instead of 37 deg (one run per side; our mapping). (left eye; unrounded 37.3 vs 37.2 deg) With PVLP141 silenced, the fly still turned away, by about 34 deg instead of 55 deg (one run per side; our mapping). With all 21-23 two-step relay neurons silenced, the fly still turned away, by about 40 deg instead of 55 deg (one run per side; our mapping). (right eye) These body runs turn the brain's firing rates into steering through our own hand-made mapping, so they show the brain result in degrees; they are not a separate test of the wiring. No scrambled brains were run at these strengths.

Relays against an activity-matched control (13 Oct 2026, our own test, pre-registered, brain only): The two sides disagree: on one side silencing the relays lowered the turn neuron's rate more than matched activity elsewhere, on the other it did not. We do not draw a conclusion. Left eye: nothing silenced 21-25 Hz, matched control 13-34 Hz, relays E2 16.0 Hz, PVLP141 17.7 Hz; right eye 40-49, 40-43, 25.7, 27.0 Hz. 5 seeds and 5 matched draws per side, 3 relay seeds; some draws include direct inputs to the turn neuron; E2 is mostly PVLP141; not fly behaviour. The 9 Oct summary line stays with a dated note (its random control removed 2-6 times as much activity).
